Checkout prices in USD, so a euro card gets converted by your bank at their rate. Cards, PayPal, Solana Pay all work. The B30 is $899 at 405 W — about €0.30/kWh that's roughly 290 kWh... sorry, 405 × 0.72 = 292 kWh a month.

What do you pay per kWh?

Free power changes everything — the whole output is yours to keep, nothing burned on electricity.

The B30 is $899, 30 TH/s, 405 W, Batch 5, ships November 30, 2026. At zero cost per kWh it runs around the clock drawing for a full block, 3.125 BTC, and stacks sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
